zoe_finance: Flagging a billing dispute from EdgeHealth (private deployment). Renewal invoice EH-2024-317 shows Support Tier "Managed Plus" and platform fee 13% but contract signed for Support "Managed" and platform fee 8%.
mike_am: Can you share the invoice lines?
zoe_finance: Billed:
```
1) OnPrem License - Managed - $90,000
2) Platform Fee (13%) - $11,700
3) Support (Managed Plus) - $18,000
```
Expected per contract:
```
2) Platform Fee (8%) - $7,200
3) Support (Managed) - $9,000
```
zoe_finance: Delta = platform $4,500 + support $9,000 = $13,500 pre-tax. System shows invoice paid.
nisha_ops: Checking renewal notes no upgrade requested. Looks like the renewal form defaulted to Plus in the UI when AM left dropdown unchanged (UX bug). Ticket OPS-1302 created.
mike_am: Customer reached out asking why they were charged more. They want a refund to the card.
zoe_finance: Refunds > $10k need VP Finance approval. Also legal wants a signed settlement if refund executed.@legal_bot any objections?
legal_bot: No objection. Recommend settlement acknowledgement to avoid chargeback. We'll draft a one-paragraph release.
billing_bot: CREDIT/REFUND PREVIEW: Account EDGEHEALTH | Amount: $13,500 | Options: apply_credit or refund_card. Outstanding balance: $0.00. If refund_card selected, initiate payout job with 2FA.
mike_am: EdgeHealth requests refund to card. They prefer quick refund.
vp_finance: Please include remediation plan and confirmation that this was UI default bug, not an AM change. Also confirm GL impact.
zoe_finance: Remediation: 1) OPS-1302 block defaulting to higher tier 2) add unit test to renewal UI 3) run a 90-day audit for similar defaults. RevRec: we'll reverse recognized revenue for the delta lines and post adj journal.
vp_finance: Approved. Refund to card OK. Capture approval note: "VP Finance 1812345678 approved refund $13,500 for EdgeHealth due to renewal form default bug; require settlement ack."
zoe_finance: Executed refund TXN REF-2024-412 and uploaded settlement ack. Billing bot updated ledger.
billing_bot: REFUND PROCESSED -> REF-2024-412 | Amount: $13,500 | Status: Completed. Ledger updated.
mike_am: Customer confirmed receipt and appreciated the fast turnaround.
zoe_finance: Closing thread. OPS-1302 & audit in flight.
